summary: syrp-plugin-api (increment 2): the Processor trait (register_params, prepare, process, process_bypassed, reset, layout negotiation, latency, Tail, bypass parameter, double-precision support), the PrepareCtx and RtCtx capability tokens with prepare_processor as the only way to make a PrepareCtx, ProcessIo carrying in-place f32/f64 audio, the sorted non-allocating ParamChanges stream and syrp-midi MIDI 1.0/UMP event buffers; new codes SYRP-PLUGIN-0004 to 0006.
